title: Popcorn in Canada | EPCOT Theme Park | Walt Disney World Resort
body_text: Canada Popcorn Cart Located in World Showcase at EPCOT Butter up to this pop-ular stop in the Canada Pavilion where you can grab handfuls of popcorn from your very own souvenir bucket before quenching your thirst with a refreshing selection of soft drinks and Canadian draft beers.View Menu American Snack Dining Plan Meals Not Accepted Operating Hours – 11:00 AM to 9:00 PM Extended Evening hours – 9:00 PM to 11:00 PM Valid admission required. A theme park reservation may be required based on admission type. An Important Message Valid admission required.
